name: Wanyra MCP
description: Zero-dependency stdio MCP server for Wanyra API (https://api.star1age.cn/en) unifying 81 live GA multimodal models across text (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Grok), 23 video generation models (MiniMax H3, Seedance 2.0/2.5, Kling 3.0 Omni, Wan 3.0/2.7, Vidu Q3/Q2 Pro, Hailuo H3, HappyHorse 1.1), 23 image models, and 7 audio models. wanyra_list_models and wanyra_estimate_cost work without an API key; chat, image, and video tools use WANYRA_API_KEY.

WANYRA_API_KEY.description: API key from https://api.star1age.cn/en (optional for catalog listing and cost estimation; required for chat, image, and video generation).
